name: DENC3SNOMEDConceptMap
title: DEN.C3 ConceptMap to SNOMED CT
description: Candidate terminology mappings for DEN.C3 local concepts to SNOMED CT. Mappings are inexact/narrower and require terminology review; unsupported concepts are explicitly unmapped.

text.div:
Mappings are candidate relationships from the source data dictionary and secondary mapping workbook. They are not independently terminology-validated. Inexact and narrower relations intentionally avoid claiming exact equivalence.

  • hypotensive-shock: Source candidate does not mean hypotensive shock exactly; validate. Source candidate does not mean hypotensive shock exactly; validate.
  • severe-bleeding: Source candidate is a morphology concept and may not represent the assessment of severe bleeding; validate.
  • severe-organ-impairment: Source candidate is narrower than severe organ impairment; validate the intended concept.
  • no-danger-sign: The supplied “No history of” qualifier does not represent current absence of danger signs.
  • oral-fluid-intake-volume: Source candidate describes oral fluid input; validate that it is suitable for the quantity observation.
